messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: Runtime queue depth > 80% for prod-us-west — Alert RUNTIME-8472. Paging oncall at 21:03 UTC.
maya (oncall): taking pager, I'm on it. Anyone with runtime context?
sam (runtime): I'm available. Seeing an embed-heavy spike from tenant 'nimbus' — many large requests, sequence lengths ~2k. Queue piling on embed workers.
maya (oncall): ok. Quick mitigation options: per-tenant cap, global max_inflight reduction, or reroute low-priority traffic to shared pool. We should do minimal blast radius.
eli (sre): cap tenant first. I'll perform a priority-slice rate-swap and lower embed concurrency.
maya (oncall): @eli go ahead. @jordan can you prep CS/Status page? I'll coordinate customer messaging.
eli (sre): executing tenant cap now:
```
PATCH /admin/tenants/nimbus/config
{ "concurrency_limit": 4, "priority_slice": "standard" }
```
ops-bot: rate-limit update applied — tenant=nimbus concurrency=4 id=rl-9921
jordan (support): CS alerted, drafting status note: brief impact summary + ETA. Will post once we confirm stabilization.
maya (oncall): also reducing global embed path max_inflight from 8 -> 3 to relieve workers. Applying safe rollout.
ops-bot: config change queued: embed.max_inflight=3 rollout=gradual-10% id=cfg-4412
sam (runtime): metrics update: queue depth dropping from 82% -> 58% within 60s of cap. Inflight embed requests down ~45%. p95 token latency stable so far.
maya (oncall): thanks. To avoid premature client aborts, bump soft timeout to 45s for long-run responses (short-term).
eli (sre): applied soft timeout tweak: `engine.timeout.soft=45s` — deployed to prod-us-west. Monitoring for errors/timeouts.
ops-bot: config applied: engine.timeout.soft=45s id=cfg-4413
sam (runtime): seeing fewer evictions and fewer timeout errors. Backpressure curve looks smoother. Will watch next 10m.
maya (oncall): Jordan, please publish status: note mitigations (tenant cap, embed concurrency reduction, timeout tweak) and that we're monitoring.
jordan (support): Posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/8472 — included customer-facing summary and internal traceback links.
maya (oncall): plan: keep tenant cap and reduced embed.max_inflight for 1 hour, then slowly revert if stable. If queue re-spikes, escalate to full traffic throttle for non-critical slices.
eli (sre): agreed. I'll set an automated rollback if errors exceed threshold.
ops-bot: alert: queue depth normalized under 60% — trending down for 3 consecutive mins.
maya (oncall): great. Closing active mitigation window, leaving controls in place for now. Will hand off to monitoring oncall. :white_check_mark:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: RUNTIME-8472 — queue depth normalized after mitigations. Duration ~12m.
